The loop in _publish pushes each constituent to storage. Storing the mirror is the purpose of the call, and the loop is bounded by MAX_CONSTITUENTS (64), which _validateComposition enforces first. The gas tests measure the 64-token case.
BPS = 10_000 already uses a digit separator. Rewriting it as 1e4 is cosmetic, and any source change alters the metadata hash, the bytecode and the deterministic deployment address.

_validateComposition reverts on the first token that is out of order or has a zero weight, and names its position. The publication is all or nothing by design: skipping a bad entry would store a mirror that differs from the spec.
